function.description: Execute a shell command in the workspace directory
function.name: shell

approved.description: Set true to explicitly approve medium/high-risk commands in supervised mode

function.description: Read file contents with line numbers. Supports partial reading via offset and limit. Extracts text from PDF; other binary files are read with lossy UTF-8 conversion.
function.name: file_read

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return (default: all)

path.description: Path to the file. Relative paths resolve from workspace; outside paths require policy allowlist.

function.description: Write contents to a file in the workspace
function.name: file_write

content.description: Content to write to the file

path.description: Path to the file. Relative paths resolve from workspace; outside paths require policy allowlist.

function.description: Edit a file by replacing an exact string match with new content
function.name: file_edit

new_string.description: The replacement text (empty string to delete the matched text)

old_string.description: The exact text to find and replace (must appear exactly once in the file)

path.description: Path to the file. Relative paths resolve from workspace; outside paths require policy allowlist.

function.description: Search for files matching a glob pattern within the workspace. Returns a sorted list of matching file paths relative to the workspace root. Examples: '**/*.rs' (all Rust files), 'src/**/mod.rs' (all mod.rs in src).
function.name: glob_search

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g. '**/*.rs', 'src/**/mod.rs'

function.description: Search file contents by regex pattern within the workspace. Supports ripgrep (rg) with grep fallback. Output modes: 'content' (matching lines with context), 'files_with_matches' (file paths only), 'count' (match counts per file). Example: pattern='fn main', include='*.rs', output_mode='content'.
function.name: content_search

context_after.description: Lines of context after each match (content mode only)

context_before.description: Lines of context before each match (content mode only)

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 1000

multiline.description: Enable multiline matching (ripgrep only, errors on grep fallback)

path.description: Directory to search in, relative to workspace root. Defaults to '.'

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern to search for

function.description: Create a scheduled cron job (shell or agent) with cron/at/every schedules. Use job_type='agent' with a prompt to run the AI agent on schedule. To deliver output to a channel (Discord, Telegram, Slack, Mattermost, Matrix, QQ), set delivery={"mode":"announce","channel":"discord","to":"<channel_id_or_chat_id>"}. This is the preferred tool for sending scheduled/delayed messages to users via channels.
function.name: cron_add

allowed_tools.description: Optional allowlist of tool names for agent jobs. When omitted, all tools remain available.

approved.description: Set true to explicitly approve medium/high-risk shell commands in supervised mode

command.description: Shell command to run (required when job_type is 'shell')

delete_after_run.description: If true, the job is automatically deleted after its first successful run. Defaults to true for 'at' schedules.

delivery.description: Optional delivery config to send job output to a channel after each run. When provided, all three of mode, channel, and to are expected.

best_effort.description: If true, a delivery failure does not fail the job itself. Defaults to true.

channel.description: Channel type to deliver output to

mode.description: 'announce' sends output to the specified channel; 'none' disables delivery

to.description: Destination ID: Discord channel ID, Telegram chat ID, Slack channel name, etc.

job_type.description: Type of job: 'shell' runs a command, 'agent' runs the AI agent with a prompt

model.description: Optional model override for agent jobs, e.g. 'x-ai/grok-4-1-fast'

name.description: Optional human-readable name for the job

prompt.description: Agent prompt to run on schedule (required when job_type is 'agent')

schedule.description: When to run the job. Exactly one of three forms must be used.

tz.description: Optional IANA timezone name, e.g. 'America/New_York'. Defaults to UTC.

oneOf.description: One-shot schedule at a specific UTC datetime. Example: {"kind":"at","at":"2025-12-31T23:59:00Z"}
Repeating interval schedule in milliseconds. Example: {"kind":"every","every_ms":3600000} runs every hour.

every_ms.description: Interval in milliseconds, e.g. 3600000 for every hour

session_target.description: Agent session context: 'isolated' starts a fresh session each run, 'main' reuses the primary session

function.description: List all scheduled cron jobs
function.name: cron_list

function.description: Remove a cron job by id
function.name: cron_remove

function.description: Patch an existing cron job (schedule, command, prompt, enabled, delivery, model, etc.)
function.name: cron_update

approved.description: Set true to explicitly approve medium/high-risk shell commands in supervised mode

job_id.description: ID of the cron job to update, as returned by cron_add or cron_list

patch.description: Fields to update. Only include fields you want to change; omitted fields are left as-is.

allowed_tools.description: Optional replacement allowlist of tool names for agent jobs

delete_after_run.description: If true, delete the job automatically after its first successful run

delivery.description: Delivery config to send job output to a channel after each run. When provided, mode, channel, and to are all expected.

best_effort.description: If true, a delivery failure does not fail the job itself. Defaults to true.

channel.description: Channel type to deliver output to

mode.description: 'announce' sends output to the specified channel; 'none' disables delivery

to.description: Destination ID: Discord channel ID, Telegram chat ID, Slack channel name, etc.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the job without deleting it

model.description: Model override for agent jobs, e.g. 'x-ai/grok-4-1-fast'

name.description: New human-readable name for the job

schedule.description: New schedule for the job. Exactly one of three forms must be used.

tz.description: Optional IANA timezone name, e.g. 'America/New_York'. Defaults to UTC.

oneOf.description: One-shot schedule at a specific UTC datetime. Example: {"kind":"at","at":"2025-12-31T23:59:00Z"}
Repeating interval schedule in milliseconds. Example: {"kind":"every","every_ms":3600000} runs every hour.

every_ms.description: Interval in milliseconds, e.g. 3600000 for every hour

session_target.description: Agent session context: 'isolated' starts fresh each run, 'main' reuses the primary session

function.description: Force-run a cron job immediately and record run history
function.name: cron_run

approved.description: Set true to explicitly approve medium/high-risk shell commands in supervised mode

function.description: List recent run history for a cron job
function.name: cron_runs

function.description: Store a fact, preference, or note in long-term memory. Use category 'core' for permanent facts, 'daily' for session notes, 'conversation' for chat context, or a custom category name.
function.name: memory_store

category.description: Memory category: 'core' (permanent), 'daily' (session), 'conversation' (chat), or a custom category name. Defaults to 'core'.

function.description: Search long-term memory for relevant facts, preferences, or context. Returns scored results ranked by relevance. Supports keyword search, time-only query (since/until), or both.
function.name: memory_recall

query.description: Keywords or phrase to search for in memory (optional if since/until provided)

search_mode.description: Search strategy: bm25 (keyword), embedding (semantic), or hybrid (both). Defaults to config value.

since.description: Filter memories created at or after this time (RFC 3339, e.g. 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z)

until.description: Filter memories created at or before this time (RFC 3339)

function.description: Remove a memory by key. Use to delete outdated facts or sensitive data. Returns whether the memory was found and removed.
function.name: memory_forget

key.description: The key of the memory to forget

function.description: Export memories as a JSON array for GDPR Art. 20 data portability. Supports filtering by namespace, session, category, and time range. Returns a structured, machine-readable JSON array of memory entries.
function.name: memory_export

category.description: Filter by category: core, daily, conversation, or a custom name.

since.description: RFC 3339 lower bound (inclusive) on created_at. Example: 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z

until.description: RFC 3339 upper bound (inclusive) on created_at. Example: 2025-12-31T23:59:59Z

function.description: Remove all memories in a namespace (category) or session. Use to bulk-delete conversation context or category-scoped data. Returns the number of deleted entries. WARNING: This operation cannot be undone.
function.name: memory_purge

namespace.description: The namespace (category) to purge. Deletes all memories in this category.

session_id.description: The session ID to purge. Deletes all memories in this session.

function.description: Manage scheduled shell-only tasks. Actions: create/add/once/list/get/cancel/remove/pause/resume. WARNING: This tool creates shell jobs whose output is only logged, NOT delivered to any channel. To send a scheduled message to Discord/Telegram/Slack/Matrix, use the cron_add tool with job_type='agent' and a delivery config like {"mode":"announce","channel":"discord","to":"<channel_id>"}.
function.name: schedule

approved.description: Set true to explicitly approve medium/high-risk shell commands in supervised mode

command.description: Shell command to execute. Required for create/add/once.

run_at.description: Absolute RFC3339 time for one-shot tasks (e.g. '2030-01-01T00:00:00Z').

function.description: Manage default model settings, scenario-based provider/model routes, classification rules, and delegate sub-agent profiles
function.name: model_routing_config

agentic.description: Enable tool-call loop mode for delegate agent

allowed_tools.description: Allowed tools for agentic delegate mode (string or string array)

api_key.description: Optional API key override for scenario route or delegate agent

classification_enabled.description: When true, upsert classification rule for this hint; false removes it

hint.description: Scenario hint name (for example: conversation, coding, reasoning)

keywords.description: Classification keywords for upsert_scenario (string or string array)

max_iterations.description: Maximum tool-call iterations for agentic delegate mode

patterns.description: Classification literal patterns for upsert_scenario (string or string array)

remove_classification.description: When remove_scenario, whether to remove matching classification rule (default true)

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt override for delegate agent

function.description: Switch the AI model at runtime. Use 'get' to see current model, 'list_providers' to see available providers, 'list_models' to see models for a provider, or 'set' to switch to a different model. The switch takes effect immediately for the current conversation.
function.name: model_switch

action.description: Action to perform: get current model, set a new model, list available providers, or list models for a provider

provider.description: Provider name (e.g., 'openai', 'anthropic', 'groq', 'ollama'). Required for 'set' and 'list_models' actions.

function.description: Manage ZeroClaw proxy settings (scope: environment | zeroclaw | services), including runtime and process env application
function.name: proxy_config

all_proxy.description: Fallback proxy URL for all protocols

clear_env.description: When action=disable, clear process proxy environment variables

no_proxy.description: Comma-separated string or array of NO_PROXY entries

services.description: Comma-separated string or array of service selectors used when scope=services

function.description: Perform structured Git operations (status, diff, log, branch, commit, add, checkout, stash). Provides parsed JSON output and integrates with security policy for autonomy controls.
function.name: git_operations

files.description: File or path to diff (for 'diff' operation, default: '.')

limit.description: Number of log entries (for 'log' operation, default: 10)

path.description: Optional subdirectory path within the workspace to run git operations in. Defaults to workspace root.

function.description: Send a Pushover notification to your device. Requires PUSHOVER_TOKEN and PUSHOVER_USER_KEY in .env file.
function.name: pushover

function.description: Perform arithmetic and statistical calculations. Supports 25 functions: add, subtract, divide, multiply, pow, sqrt, abs, modulo, round, log, ln, exp, factorial, sum, average, median, mode, min, max, range, variance, stdev, percentile, count, percentage_change, clamp. Use this tool whenever you need to compute a numeric result instead of guessing.
function.name: calculator

a.description: First operand. Required for: pow, modulo, percentage_change.

b.description: Second operand. Required for: pow, modulo, percentage_change.

decimals.description: Number of decimal places for rounding. Required for: round.

function.description: Calculation to perform. Arithmetic: add(values), subtract(values), divide(values), multiply(values), pow(a,b), sqrt(x), abs(x), modulo(a,b), round(x,decimals). Logarithmic/exponential: log(x,base?), ln(x), exp(x), factorial(x). Aggregation: sum(values), average(values), count(values), min(values), max(values), range(values). Statistics: median(values), mode(values), variance(values), stdev(values), percentile(values,p). Utility: percentage_change(a,b), clamp(x,min_val,max_val).

values.description: Array of numeric values. Required for: add, subtract, divide, multiply, sum, average, median, mode, min, max, range, variance, stdev, percentile, count.

x.description: Input number. Required for: sqrt, abs, exp, ln, log, factorial.

function.description: Get current weather conditions and up to 3-day forecast for any location worldwide. Supports city names (in any language or script), airport IATA codes (e.g. 'LAX'), GPS coordinates (e.g. '51.5,-0.1'), postal/zip codes, and domain-based geolocation. No API key required. Units default to metric (°C, km/h, mm) but can be switched to imperial (°F, mph, inches) per request.
function.name: weather

days.description: Number of forecast days to include (0–3). 0 returns current conditions only. Default: 1.

location.description: Location to get weather for. Accepts city names in any language/script, IATA airport codes, GPS coordinates (e.g. '35.6762,139.6503'), postal/zip codes, or a domain name for geolocation (e.g. 'stackoverflow.com').

units.description: Unit system. 'metric' = °C, km/h, mm (default). 'imperial' = °F, mph, inches.

function.description: Push rendered content (HTML, SVG, Markdown) to a live web canvas that users can see in real-time. Actions: render (push content), snapshot (get current content), clear (reset canvas), eval (evaluate JS expression in canvas context). Each canvas is identified by a canvas_id string.
function.name: canvas

action.description: Action to perform on the canvas.

canvas_id.description: Unique identifier for the canvas. Defaults to 'default'.

content_type.description: Content type for render action: html, svg, markdown, or text.

expression.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate (for eval action). The result is returned as text. Evaluated client-side in the canvas iframe.

function.description: Run a prompt through an LLM with no tool access and return the response. Optionally validates the output against a JSON Schema. Ideal for structured data extraction, classification, summarization, and transformation tasks.
function.name: llm_task

model.description: Optional model override (e.g. 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6'). Defaults to the configured default model.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to the LLM.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema to validate the LLM response against. When provided, the LLM is instructed to return valid JSON matching this schema.

temperature.description: Optional temperature override (0.0-2.0). Defaults to the configured default temperature.

function.description: Open an approved HTTPS URL in the system browser. Security constraints: allowlist-only domains, no local/private hosts, no scraping.
function.name: browser_open

url.description: HTTPS URL to open in the system browser

function.description: Web/browser automation with pluggable backends (agent-browser, rust-native, computer_use). Supports DOM actions plus optional OS-level actions (mouse_move, mouse_click, mouse_drag, key_type, key_press, screen_capture) through a computer-use sidecar. Use 'snapshot' to map interactive elements to refs (@e1, @e2). Enforces browser.allowed_domains for open actions.
function.name: browser

action.description: Browser action to perform (OS-level actions require backend=computer_use)

compact.description: For snapshot: remove empty structural elements

fill_value.description: For find with fill action: value to fill

find_action.description: For find: action to perform on found element

interactive_only.description: For snapshot: only show interactive elements

key.description: Key to press (Enter, Tab, Escape, etc.)

text.description: Text to type or wait for

function.description: Make HTTP requests to external APIs. Supports GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD, OPTIONS methods. Security constraints: allowlist-only domains, no local/private hosts, configurable timeout and response size limits.
function.name: http_request

body.description: Optional request body (for POST, PUT, PATCH requests)

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers as key-value pairs (e.g., {"Authorization": "Bearer token", "Content-Type": "application/json"})

method.description: HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD, OPTIONS)

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL to request

function.description: Fetch a web page and return its content as clean plain text. HTML pages are automatically converted to readable text. JSON and plain text responses are returned as-is. Only GET requests; follows redirects. Falls back to Firecrawl for JS-heavy/bot-blocked sites (if enabled). Security: allowlist-only domains, no local/private hosts.
function.name: web_fetch

url.description: The HTTP or HTTPS URL to fetch

function.description: Search the web for information. Returns relevant search results with titles, URLs, and descriptions. Use this to find current information, news, or research topics.
function.name: web_search_tool

query.description: The search query. Be specific for better results.

function.description: Create, list, verify, and restore workspace backups
function.name: backup

confirm.description: Confirm restore (required for actual restore, default false)

function.description: Extract plain text from a PDF file in the workspace. Returns all readable text. Image-only or encrypted PDFs return an empty result. Requires the 'rag-pdf' build feature.
function.name: pdf_read

path.description: Path to the PDF file. Relative paths resolve from workspace; outside paths require policy allowlist.

function.description: Capture a screenshot of the current screen. Returns the file path and base64-encoded PNG data.
function.name: screenshot

filename.description: Optional filename (default: screenshot_<timestamp>.png). Saved in workspace.

region.description: Optional region for macOS: 'selection' for interactive crop, 'window' for front window. Ignored on Linux.

function.description: Read image file metadata (format, dimensions, size) and optionally return base64-encoded data.
function.name: image_info

include_base64.description: Include base64-encoded image data in output (default: false)

path.description: Path to the image file (absolute or relative to workspace)

function.description: List all active conversation sessions with their channel, last activity time, and message count.
function.name: sessions_list

function.description: Read the message history of a specific session by its session ID. Returns the last N messages.
function.name: sessions_history

limit.description: Max messages to return, from most recent (default: 20)

session_id.description: The session ID to read history from (e.g. telegram__user123)

function.description: Send a message to a specific session by its session ID. The message is appended to the session's conversation history as a 'user' message, enabling inter-agent communication.
function.name: sessions_send

function.description: Create a poll in a messaging channel. For Telegram/Discord uses native polls; for other channels formats as a numbered text message with emoji reactions for voting.
function.name: poll

channel.description: Target channel name. Defaults to the first available channel if omitted.

recipient.description: Recipient/chat identifier within the channel (e.g., chat_id for Telegram, channel_id for Slack)

function.description: Add or remove an emoji reaction on a message in any active channel. Provide the channel name (e.g. 'discord', 'slack'), the platform channel ID, the platform message ID, and the emoji (Unicode character or platform shortcode).
function.name: reaction

action.description: Whether to add or remove the reaction (default: 'add')

channel.description: Name of the channel to react in (e.g. 'discord', 'slack', 'telegram')

channel_id.description: Platform-specific channel/conversation identifier (e.g. Discord channel snowflake, Slack channel ID)

emoji.description: Emoji to react with (Unicode character or platform shortcode)

message_id.description: Platform-scoped message identifier to react to

function.description: Ask the user a question and wait for their response. Sends the question to a messaging channel and blocks until the user replies or the timeout expires. Optionally provide choices for structured responses.
function.name: ask_user

channel.description: Target channel name. Defaults to the first available channel if omitted.

choices.description: Optional list of choices (renders as buttons on Telegram, numbered list on CLI)

question.description: The question to ask the user

timeout_secs.description: Seconds to wait for a response (default: 300)

function.description: Escalate a situation to a human operator with urgency routing. Sends a structured message to the active channel. High/critical urgency also triggers a Pushover mobile notification when configured. Optionally blocks to wait for a human response.
function.name: escalate_to_human

timeout_secs.description: Seconds to wait for a response when wait_for_response is true (default: 600)

urgency.description: Urgency level (default: medium). high/critical triggers Pushover notification.

wait_for_response.description: Block and return the human's reply (default: false)
